scope: Four synthetic scenarios; one run each. This is a smoke evaluation, not a production accuracy estimate. Only exact citations and supplied policy references are validated mechanically.

assessment.summary: The collector note falsely claims the customer promised to pay INR 18,500, made a part-payment agreement, and raised no dispute, whereas the transcript shows the customer explicitly disputed the amount, refused to pay without a breakup, and rejected the collector's unapproved personal payment handle.

noteAssessment.explanation: The collector note states that the customer confirmed a promise to pay and made no dispute, which directly contradicts the transcript where the customer disputes the amount and refuses to make a payment promise.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Haan, lekin amount galat lag raha hai. Mere hisaab se 15,000 due hai, 18,500 nahi.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.

findings.title: Inaccurate Note Fabrication of Promise and Omission of Dispute
findings.explanation: The collector recorded a false promise to pay and a part-payment agreement while omitting the customer's explicit dispute and refusal to pay.

citations.quote: Customer confirmed a promise to pay INR 18,500 by Friday, 2 October 2026. Customer agreed to make an immediate INR 5,000 part-payment. No dispute raised.
Nahi, pehle charges ka breakup bhejiye. Jab tak amount clear nahi hota, main payment ka promise nahi kar sakta.

findings.title: Direction to Unapproved Payment Destination
findings.explanation: The collector directed the customer to transfer funds to a personal address (amit.collect@personal-pay) which is absent from the approved directory.

citations.quote: Aap filhaal 5,000 amit.collect@personal-pay par transfer kar dijiye, baaki baad mein dekh lenge.

citation.quote: Aap filhaal 5,000 amit.collect@personal-pay par transfer kar dijiye, baaki baad mein dekh lenge.

assessment.recommendationReason: The case exhibits serious policy violations, including fabricating a customer promise in the notes and directing payments to an unapproved personal address.

assessment.recommendationReason: Request the missing previous call recording and message to verify the payment details discussed prior to this call.
